title: Points Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Points collections, covering the set of point objects owned by one SOP and the special functions used to count, index, and iterate points.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs the point collection owned by one SOP, such as op('box1').points.
Use len(Points) to count points and [index] to retrieve a specific td.Point by integer index.
Use the iterator protocol to iterate over each point in the SOP point collection.
Do not use Points Class as a POP point iteration API; use POP Class metadata methods and POP operators for POP geometry.
Do not invent collection-specific mutating methods for Points; the official page lists no operator specific methods.
